notes.title: One-Year Anniversary 🥳
notes.notes:
One-Year Anniversary 🥳

Carto has been released one year ago.

After launched, we enjoy finding out how players play our game. Some laugh at the puns while streaming, some accompany with their partners and kids to solve puzzles, and some challenge themselves by getting all the achievements on their own.

Fans even turn Carto into pixel art, 3D model, paper doll and clay!

We put these creations on a wall and strongly recommend you to check it out:
https://padlet.com/soymilkmusic/carto

Thank you all for loving Carto 🙏

- Sunhead Games

notes.title: First 40% off sale!
notes.notes:
Hello current and would-be cartographers!

If you’ve been waiting to map the lands of Carto, or know someone who might enjoy our unique adventure game, now’s the time! We’re having our first 40% off Steam sale from 08/12-08/16.

While we’re here, we thought we’d share a [url=https://twitter.com/sunheadgames/status/1421300013393608705]little video[/url] with you, which we were asked to make in case we won the Independent Games Festival award we were nominated for. We didn’t win, but we’re still grateful for the nomination, and to all of our fans who’ve been enjoying the game, leaving us lovely reviews, and helping guide Carto home!

notes.title: IGF Nomination and Other News!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We’re excited to share the news that Carto was recently nominated in the Independent Games Festival (IGF) awards, both for Excellence in Visual Art and an honorable mention for the Seumas McNally Grand Prize. We’ve followed IGF for a long time and submitted to it several times, so it’s a great honor for us to be nominated this year.

Carto was also recently nominated for a couple other awards:
- The Webby Awards - Games: Family & Kids category
- Anifilm Festival - Excellence in Graphics / Best Children Game

We’re greatly encouraged by these nominations, whether we win or not.

We’ve also been greatly encouraged by our players who have left reviews and comments online, streamers of our game who are always energetic and funny to watch, and artists who have made adorable fanart of our characters. We’d like to thank you for all of your kindness and excitement around Carto - making this game was a great challenge for us, and your feedback has made it worth the journey.

Lastly, the game will be on sale this week as part of a Humble Games promotion, 30% off between 05/13-05/17. In case you’d like to tell a friend!

- Sunhead Games

notes.title: Update on Control Remapping!
notes.notes:
Carto now supports configuration for keyboard and gamepad.

We have fixed some bugs and typos in all languages.

Also, some of the puzzles are made more enjoyable and reasonable.

Thank you all for playing our games and happy holidays!

notes.title: Carto Soundtrack OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Reliving the best moments of the journey with Carto, the Carto Soundtrack composed by [b]Eddie Yu[/b], is now available on Steam, as well as the streaming services like Spotify and Apple Music.

You could also purchase the album via [url=https://soymilkmusic.bandcamp.com/album/carto-original-game-soundtrack][b]Bandcamp[/b][/url] to support [b]Eddie Yu[/b] directly. [b]Eddie Yu[/b] not only composes the music for Carto, but also is responsible for those cute sound effect in the game.

P.S. The amazing album cover art is designed by our artist [b]Kuan Hung Chen[/b].

notes.title: Carto is OUT NOW for PC and Mac!
notes.notes:
After several years of development, we at Sunhead Games are proud and excited to say that our chill, world-shifting game Carto is out now! With a 10% launch discount for the first week of release, a small gift for everyone who’s been patient with us.

We made a cozy little adventure game about friends, family, and community, and exploring cultures beyond your own. You may have seen our central gameplay mechanic in our trailers - manipulating the game’s map to change the world around you - and we’ve tried to build on it in unique and interesting ways throughout the course of the game. Let us know what you think!

Thanks for going with us on this journey, and enjoy your time exploring with Carto!

- Sunhead Games

notes.title: Rearrange a lovely hand-drawn world in Carto
notes.notes:
Carto

has been in the works for a while, but it’s on the final stretch now, as developers Sunhead Games announced an autumn 2020 launch, and slipped a new trailer into place next to the river, allowing us to… okay I should probably explain this one first.

It’s a puzzle game in which the land underneath you is made of large tiles. You play as Carto, a cute little explorer with the power to rearrange those tiles, which opens up new paths to help you get home, and helping out lots of people along the way.
